title: Latency split: actuation confirmed, sensing probe voided by protocol
question: How does the 15-19 ms actuation figure decompose, and how stale is the gyro reading?
headline: Parts 1-2 reconfirm: loop jitter <=1 ms hidden in a 5 ms worst period, actuation 14-20 ms. Part 3 (gyro response 26-69 ms) is VOID: the streaming bug ate the stand-it-up prompt and the robot lay flat throughout, so the reaction kick never matched the protocol. Rerun standing — though even these tainted numbers hint the sensing chain is not fast.
hub_output: part 3: stand the robot UP on the ground, steady it lightly. 6 trials.
part 3 done: gyro-response minus ~1 ms of body spin-up = sensing lag.
compare with part 2: encoder time - gyro time ~= stiction/backlash takeup
